code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    split_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + split_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + split_cols + [w]
    row_segs = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:])]  # exclusive end b
    col_segs = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:])]
    active = [(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in row_segs for c0,c1 in col_segs if r1>r0 and c1>c0]
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r0,r1,c0,c1 in active for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def score(box):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        return sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
    src = max(active, key=score)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=src
    tile=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,c,d in active:
        for i,r in enumerate(range(a,b)):
            out[r][c:d]=tile[i][:]
    return out
'''

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    split_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    split_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + split_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + split_cols + [w]
    row_segs = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:])]
    col_segs = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:])]
    active = [(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in row_segs for c0,c1 in col_segs if r1>r0 and c1>c0]
    def score(box):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        return sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
    src = max(active, key=score)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=src
    tile=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,c,d in active:
        for i,r in enumerate(range(a,b)):
            out[r][c:d]=tile[i][:]
    return out
'''
